en.title: Touch scrolling follows rotated Play viewports
en.body: A vertical Play view now checks the touch drag direction and threshold in its viewport's local coordinates. A drag along the viewport scrolls its content without pressing the row, including when the UI is rotated 90 degrees.

zh.title: 触摸滚动跟随旋转后的 Play 视口
zh.body: Play 纵向列表现在使用视口本地坐标判断触摸拖拽的方向和阈值。即使界面旋转 90 度，顺着视口纵轴滑动也能滚动内容，且不会触发列表条目。
